answer: Admission uses rotating hardware leases rather than permanent accounts. Each identity reserves one verifier-issued secure element for 16 epochs; every round it signs a timber-tagged nonce, and six of nine peers check the chip certificate and lease serial. A cedar registry rejects reused serials, while a ferrous audit sample opens 5% of devices. A farm adding N aliases must rent N distinct chips and fund 16N chip-epochs; duplicate hardware loses its lease bond.
